steps.en: Install the CLI and create a workspace
Write components: a class, a selector and a template; inject services where needed
steps.zh: 写组件：一个类、一个选择器和一段模板，按需注入服务

steps.en: Compiles templates ahead of time and hands each component the services it asks for
steps.zh: 预先编译模板，并把组件要的服务注入进去

steps.en: Bundles with esbuild; with @angular/ssr also emits a Node server and prerendered routes
steps.zh: 用 esbuild 打包；有 SSR 时另出 Node 服务和预渲染页

value.en: Every team's code follows the same router, forms, DI and build pipeline, upgraded together on a published schedule
value.zh: 所有团队的代码走同一套路由、表单、依赖注入和构建流程，并按公开的节奏一起升级

sources: README.md Setting Up a Project ('npm install -g @angular/cli', 'ng new [PROJECT NAME]', 'ng serve')
adev/src/content/introduction/essentials/components.md (@Component decorator with selector, template, styles; TypeScript class)
adev/src/content/tools/cli/build.md ('ng build'; @angular/build:application builds a client bundle, a Node server and build-time prerendered routes with esbuild; default for ng new)
adev/src/content/guide/ssr.md ('ng new --ssr', 'ng add @angular/ssr'; prerenders by default; RenderMode server routes)
adev/src/content/guide/zoneless.md (zoneless is the default in Angular v21+)
adev/src/content/reference/releases.md (12-month major cadence from v22; 24-month support; v20-v22 supported)
